hero.subtitle: We are turning a vacant building in the historic centre of Pinhel into an international centre for training, incubation, culture, technology and cooperation.
hero.disclaimer: Official campaign on GoFundMe, with phased goals and a commitment to transparency about every euro.

video.title: See why this project needs to happen now
video.description: Global Village is not an abstract idea. It is a concrete response that breathes new life into a vacant building in Pinhel and creates a space for training, culture, innovation and community.

about.description: Global Village – International Training Center (GV-ITC) is a service platform in Pinhel: training, project incubation, cooperation networks and on-the-ground implementation.
about.description_2: It is promoted by Hawk Stars, an association for Education, Innovation and Social Development founded in Pinhel in 2022. Think Global, Act Local.

spaces.title_prefix: A vacant building in the historic centre,
spaces.description: The architectural project restores a group of buildings next to Largo General Castro, standing still for a decade, into an inclusive space accessible to everyone.
spaces.footnote: It also includes the “Social Impact” Art Gallery, a Mini-FabLab and the Hawk Stars office. Images: renders from the architectural project.

faq.description: Can't find the answer? Write to us at fundraising@hawkstars.org.

how_to_support.question: How can I support?
how_to_support.answer: By contributing to the official GoFundMe campaign, sharing it with people who believe in the future of inland Portugal, supporting as a company, or through the Hawk Stars Art Gallery and charity shop.

goal_not_met.question: What happens if the goal is not reached?
goal_not_met.answer: The project moves forward in phases. Every euro raised goes into the first technical and operational steps (licensing, engineering, start of works), and structural works begin once the first €40,000 is raised.

other_ways.question: Can I donate outside the platform?
other_ways.answer: Yes. You can donate directly to Hawk Stars, buy from the Social Impact Art Gallery or the online shop, or talk to us about corporate support and patronage.

rewards.question: How do rewards work?
rewards.answer: Choose a reward, contribute the matching amount on GoFundMe and email us at fundraising@hawkstars.org. We will arrange the delivery or experience details with you.

transparency.question: How can I follow how the funds are used?
transparency.answer: We regularly update the amount raised, the project phases and the news on this page and on our social media.

companies.question: Are there options for companies?
companies.answer: Yes: room and space naming, logo walls, brand partnerships and patronage. Talk to us to find the best option.

abroad.question: Can I support from abroad?
abroad.answer: Yes. GoFundMe accepts contributions from many countries and currencies.

receipt.question: How do I get a receipt?
receipt.answer: GoFundMe emails you a receipt after your contribution. For donations and corporate support for tax purposes, contact us and Hawk Stars will issue a receipt.
